name: thesis-mcwm-context-v7
selection: For each training seed, choose each context coefficient and the best global fixed coefficient using only the other seed's ten development days. Fit a frozen shared-diagonal Gaussian context recognizer on the other seed's nonoverlapping physical-transition blocks from all fixed arms. Deterministic tie order is ascending coefficient.
causal_scope: Static source training contexts only. At each source collection boundary, update belief using newly completed nonterminal positive-duration transitions, resetting the history at episode terminals. Change only the generated-model TD coefficient; no online target gradients and no deployed context actor.
primary_comparison: Fresh fixed-original, cross-fitted best-global-fixed, true-context, and causal recognized-context on ten test days per seed/context; all three fixed coefficients are retained
interpretation: Prospective development branch with disjoint coefficient-selection and final test days; two reused offline initializer seeds, not independent research confirmation. No coefficient mapping is taken from v5 evaluation outcomes. All positive and negative results retained. Single-factor and within-day switching tests follow only after the static control-space study.
